name: RC-B10-0476/2026 – § 21/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Russian strikes in the EU, particularly on Black Sea shipping, threatening human life, regional stability and food security
part_text: ‘Underlines that the protection of Black Sea shipping and Danube transport routes is essential to food security and the livelihoods of farmers, transport workers and port communities;’
